# TODOs for Project

- [x] Configure reverse proxy

- [x] Optimize reload in client to remove flicker

- [x] Optimize html code: use grid or flexbox, responsive design

- [x] Put code in git repository and upload it to Opencode.de
- [x] Return 404 - not Found if a room / resource is undefined
- [x] Add test support
- [x] Remove 404 error for GET <http://localhost:8001/favicon.ico>
stages:
  - build

build-image:
  stage: build

  image:
    name: gcr.io/kaniko-project/executor:v1.23.2-debug
    entrypoint: [""]

  variables:
    IMAGE_TAG: "${CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE}:${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}"

  script:
    # create Docker authentication for GitLab Container Registry (Dependency Proxy Server)
    - mkdir -p /kaniko/.docker
    - >
      echo "{\"auths\":{\"$CI_DEPENDENCY_PROXY_SERVER\":{\"username\":\"$CI_DEPENDENCY_PROXY_USER\",\"password\":\"$CI_DEPENDENCY_PROXY_PASSWORD\"}}}" 
      > /kaniko/.docker/config.json

    # Build Image and push to registry
    - >
      /kaniko/executor
      --context "${CI_PROJECT_DIR}"
      --dockerfile "${CI_PROJECT_DIR}/Dockerfile"
      --destination "${IMAGE_TAG}"
      --destination "${CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE}:latest".opencode:
